meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把动画帧脚本渲染成成片视频,并发布到云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把动画或视频素材批量渲染成片并发布到云端
copy.tagline_en: Render animation frames into finished videos and publish them to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to render animated compositions into finished videos and ship them at scale

howto.what: Claude 会用 HyperFrames CLI 走开发循环:初始化项目、在本地目录里搜现成动效、写合成、跑检查、开预览,并只在你同意后才渲染,再校验输出文件。
howto.when: 当你用 HyperFrames 做视频合成、需要单条或批量渲染,或排查构建、渲染失败时接管。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes init 建一个新视频项目
say.note: 生成居中的空白项目结构

say.text: 在目录里找一下“逐行显示标题”这个动效
say.note: 用 catalog 在本地搜索动效

say.text: 跑一下 check,然后开预览给我看
say.note: 先 lint 再开浏览器预览

howto.what_en: Claude runs the HyperFrames CLI loop: scaffold a project, search the local catalog for motion, lint and check the composition, open a preview, and render only after your approval, then verify the output file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work on HyperFrames video compositions, need a single or batch render, or are diagnosing build or render failures.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new HyperFrames project with init
Search the catalog for a headline reveal animation
Run check, then open the preview for me
